spans.s:
n. (-रं)
The blue lotus, (Nymphaea coerulea.)
E.
इन्दं from इदि to possess great power, and वर what chooses, preeminent above other flowers: see इन्दीवर.

m. (रः)
A large bee.
E.
इदि to possess great power, deriv. irr.

f. (-रा)
A name of LAKṢMĪ, the wife of VIṢṆU.
E.
इदि as above, and रा who gives.

n. (-यं)
The lotus, (Nymphaea lotus.)
E.
इन्दिरा LAKṢMĪ, and आलय an abode; this goddess issued at the creation from the petals of the flower.

n. (-रं)
The blue lotus.
E.
इन्दिरा the goddess, and वर what is best; a flower beloved by LAKṢMĪ.

n. (-रं)
The blue lotus, (Nymphaea coerulea.)
E.
इन्दि for इन्दिरा q. v. the rest as in the preceding; also इन्दीवर and इन्दीवार.

n. (-रं)
See the preceding.
f. (-री)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosus).
E.
as before.

n. (रं)
See इन्दिवर.

m. (-न्दुः)
1 The moon.
2 Camphor.
E.
उन्द to wet or moisten; उ Uṇādi affix, and the initial changed to इ.

n. (-लं)
The white lotus.
E.
इन्दु the moon, and कमल the lotus.

f. (-ला)
A digit of the moon.
E.
इन्दु and कला a digit.

f. (-का)
The Ketakī flower.
E.
इन्दु and कलिका a bud.

m. (-न्तः)
The lunar gem, the moon-stone.
f. (-न्ता)
Night.
E.
इन्दु and कान्त a master or husband.

m. (-कः)
The ocean.
E.
इन्दु and जनक a parent; the moon was produced amongst other things at the churning of the ocean.

f. (-जा)
The Narmadā or commonly Nerbudda river in the Dekhin.
E.
इन्दु and जा born; the daughter of the moon.

m. (-लः)
A portion of the moon, a digit, a crescent, &c.
E.
इन्दु and दल a leaf.

m. (-त्रः)
A name of BUDHA, regent, of the planet MERCURY.
E.
इन्दु and पुत्र the son: the son of CANDRA or the moon.

m. (-भृत्)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
इन्दु and भृत् who nourishes; ŚIVA wears a half moon on his forehead.

n. (-लं)
The orb or disc of the moon.
E.
इन्दु and मण्डल sphere.

f. (-ती)
1 Day of full moon.
2 Name of a princess married to AJA the son of RAGHU.
E.
इन्दु and मतुप् poss. affix, fem. ङीप्.

m. (-रः)
A rat.
E.
उन्द to moisten, उरच् affix, the initial is changed to इ.

n. (-त्नं)
A pearl.
E.
इन्दु and रत्न a gem.

f. (-खा)
A digit of the moon.
E.
इन्दु and रेखा a line.

f. (-खा)
1 A digit of the moon.
2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
3 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.)
4 A kind of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen): see यमानिका.
E.
इन्दु and लेखा a line.

n. (-कं)
Silver.
E.
इन्दु and लोह iron, कन् added.

f. (-ल्ली)
The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.)
E.
इन्दु and वल्ली a creeper.

n. (-तं)
A religious observance depending on the age of the moon; diminishing the quantity of food by a certain portion daily, for a fortnight or a month, &c.
E.
इन्दु and व्रत a religious obligation.

m. (-न्द्रः)
1 The deity presiding over Svarga or the Hindu paradise, and the secondary divinities; he is also regent of the east quarter, and is more particularly the deity of the atmosphere, corresponding in many respects with the Grecian

JOVE.
2

The Supreme Being, (according to the Vedānta,) or the deity INDRA in that capacity.
3 Supremacy, supreme power or authority.
4 An Āditya, one of the twelve demigods so called.
5 One of the Yogas, or divisions of a circle on the plane of the ecliptic.
6 The human or animal soul, the portion of spirit residing in the body.
7

Night.
8

A plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica, &c.) see कुटज.
9 An organ of sense.
10 (In composition) Best, excellent.
11 The 14th lunation of the month Jyeṣṭha.
12 One of the nine divisions of Jambu Dvīpa, or the known continent.
f. (-न्द्रा)
1 The name of a plant, (Marjoram?) see फणिम्भक.
2 The wife of INDRA.
E.
इदि to possess supreme power, and रन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-कं)
An assembly-room, a hall.
E.
इन्द्र excellent, and क what sounds, from कै and ड aff.

m. (-लः)
The mountain Mandara, a fabulous mountain with which the ocean was churned.
E.
इन्द्र and कील a pin or bolt.

m. (-रः)
INDRA'S elephant.
E.
इन्द्र and कुञ्जर an elephant.

m. (-षः)
1 A platform, a scaffold.
2 A projection of the roof of a house, forming a kind of balcony or terrace.
3 A pin or bracket projecting from the wall.
E.
इन्द्र best, and कोष a place.

m. (-ग्रः)
An insect, (Coccinella of various kinds.)
E.
इन्द्र best, गो light, and प from पा who nourishes or possesses.

n. (-न्दः)
A necklace of a thousand strings.
E.
इन्द्र best, and छन्दस् a necklace, &c.

n. (-लं)
1 Conjuring, juggling.
2 Deception, cheating.
3 Trick or stratagem in war.
E.
इन्द्र an organ of sense, and जाल a net.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 A juggler, a conjuror.
2 Deceptive, unreal.
E.
इन्द्रजाल illusion, and ठक् aff.

m. (-जित्)
The son of RĀVAṆA.
E.
इन्द्र and जित् who conquers: the conqueror of INDRA.

m. (-यी)
LAKṢMAṆA, the brother of RĀMA.
E.
इन्द्रजित् and विजयिन् a victor, the conqueror of INDRAJIT.

n. (-लं)
A flock of cotton, a flocculent seed, &c. blown about in the air.
E.
इन्द्र and तूल cotton: INDRA'S cotton.

n. (-कं)
See the preceding.
E.
as before, कण् added.

m. (-रुः)
A tree, (Pinus devadaru.)
E.
इन्द्र and दारु tree.

n. (-द्रुः)
A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna, Rox.)
E.
इन्द्र and द्रु a tree; a staff of which is fit to carry the banner of INDRA.

m. (-मः)
See the preceding.
E.
as before.

m. (-लः)
A sapphire.
E.
इन्द्र best, and नील blue.

m. (-कः)
An emerald.
E.
see the preceding.

f. (-ष्पा)
A medicinal plant; also अग्निजिह्वा.
E.
इन्द्र and पुष्पा a flower: also इन्द्रपुष्पिका.

f. (-ता)
The asterism Puṣya.
E.
इन्द्र and पुरोहिता priest, INDRA presiding over it.

m. (-स्थः)
Ancient Dehli.
E.
इन्द्र the deity, and प्रस्थ who presides.

n. (-णं)
INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
इन्द्र and प्रहरण a weapon.

n. (-जं)
Dried ginger.
E.
इन्द्र best, and भेषज medicament.

m. (-कः)
A dog.
E.
इन्द्र, मह a sacrifice, and कामुक desirous.

n. (-लं)
A flock of cotton: see इन्द्रतूल.

mn. (-वः-वं)
The seed of the Wrightea antidysenterica.
E.
इन्द्र the plant, and यव seed: it is used medicinally in cases of diarrhoea, dysentery, &c.

mn. (-प्तः-प्तं)
Morbid baldness, falling of the hair of the head: according to some authorities, loss of beard.
E.
इन्द्र best, लुप्त lost.

m. (-कः)
See the preceding.
E.
as before, वुन् aff.

m. (-कः)
Svarga or paradise, the heaven of INDRA.
E.
इन्द्र and लोक world.

INDRA.
2

A guest, hospitality to whom secures paradise.
E.
इन्द्रलोक and ईश lord.

f. (-का)
Colocynth, a wild bitter gourd, (Cucumis colocynthis.)
E.
कन् added to इन्द्रवारुणी.

f. (-णी)
See the preceding.
E.
इन्द्र and वरुण the two deities so called, affixes अण् and ङीप्; the favourite plant of INDRA and VARUṆA.

m. (-क्षः)
A kind of fir: see देवदारु.
E.
इन्द्र for any god, वृक्ष a tree.

n. (-तं)
One of the duties of a king, to distribute gratification, as INDRA pours down rain.
E.
इन्द्र and व्रत observance.

f. (-द्धा)
A sore, an ulcer.

f. (-क्तिः)
INDRĀṆĪ, the wife or personified energy of INDRA.
E.
इन्द्र and शक्ति power.

m. (-र्णिः)
The last of the fourteen Manus.
E.
इन्द्र and सावर्णि the son of the sun.

m. (-तः)
The monkey king BĀLĪ.
E.
इन्द्र and सुत a son; the son of INDRA: the epithet is also applied to ARJUNA and JAYANTA.

m. (-सः)
A shrub, the leaves of which are used in discutient applications, (Vitex negundo); also सिन्दुवार.
E.
इन्द्र best, सु good, and रस juice; whose juice is excellent.

m. (-सः)
See the preceding.
E.
as before, the pen. being changed to इ.

m. (-नुः)
The son of INDRA: see इन्द्रसुत.

m. (-मः)
Frost.

f. (-का)
Vitex negundo: see इन्द्रसुरस.
E.
कन् added to the next word.

f. (-णी)
1 The wife of

INDRA.
2

A plant, (Vitex negundo): see the preceding.
E.
इन्द्र, ङीष् affix, and आनुक augment.

m. (-जः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
इन्द्र and अनुज younger born: the younger brother of INDRA.

m. (-धः)
The rainbow.
f. (-धा)
A kind of leech of various tints on the back.
E.
इन्द्र and आयुध a weapon; INDRA'S weapon.

m. (-रिः)
An Asura or demon.
E.
इन्द्र and अरि an enemy.

m. (-जः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
इन्द्र and अवरज after-born: the younger brother of INDRA.

m. (-नः)
1 Hemp, dried and chewed.
2 The shrub which bears the seed used as jeweller's weight, (Abrus precatorius).
E.
इन्द्र and अशन food: the food of INDRA.

n. (-नं)
1 The throne of

INDRA.
2

Any throne.
E.
इन्द्र and असन a seat.

n. (-यं)
1 An organ of sense divided into three classes, Jñānendriyas, Karmendriyas, and Antarindriyas, or organs of perception and action, and the internal organs; the first are the eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin; the second, the organ of speech or larynx, hand, foot, anus, and parts of generation; the last are, Manas the mind or organ of thought; Buddhi the organ of apprehension; Ahaṅkāra the organ of selfishness; and Citta the heart or organ of feeling.
2 Semen virile.
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Done, seen, given, &c. by INDRA.
E.
इन्द्र the soul or self, and इयच् affix, deriv. irr. what is with difficulty restrained by the soul, or इन्द्र the deity, and घ aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Perceptible, capable of being ascertained by the senses.
E.
इन्द्रिय and गोचर perceptible.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Imperceptible.
E.
इन्द्रिय and अगोचर imperceptible.

m. (-मः)
The senses or organs of sense collectively.
E.
इन्द्रिय and ग्राम here, assemblage.

n. (-नं)
The faculty of perception, sense, consciousness.
E.
इन्द्रिय and ज्ञान knowledge.

m. (-हः)
Restraining the organs of sense.
E.
इन्द्रिय and निग्रह restraint.

f. (द्धिः)
Perception, the exercise of any sense, the faculty of any organ.
E.
इन्द्रिय and बुद्धि knowledge.

n. (-नं)
Any excitement of sense, an object of perception, a stimulus, &c.
E.
इन्द्रिय and बोधन waking.

m. (-र्गः)
The organs of sense collectively.
E.
इन्द्रिय and वर्ग a class.

f. (-त्तिः)
Erroneous or vicious perception.
E.
इन्द्रिय and विप्रतिपत्ति perversion.

m. (-पः)
1 Unconsciousness, insensibility.
2 The end of the world.
E.
इन्द्रिय and स्वाप sleep.

n. (-नं)
The body.
E.
इन्द्रिय and आयतन a mansion: the residence of the senses.

m. (-र्थः)
An object of sense, as sound, smell, &c.
E.
इन्द्रिय and अर्थ an object.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Stoicism, philosophy, detachment from sensual objects.
E.
इन्द्रिय and असङ्ग detachment.

m. (-ज्यः)
The name of VṚHASPATI, the preceptor of the gods.
E.
इन्द्र and इज्य to be worshipped; venerable to the deities.
